description: This is a PHP unit test class for the BuzzLikeDao, testing methods related to liking/unliking shares and comments in the Buzz feature of OrangeHRM, including retrieval and counting of likes. It sets up test data and mocks dependencies such as DateTimeHelperService.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing BuzzLikeDao functionality in OrangeHRM, including saving, deleting, retrieving and counting likes on shares and comments.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and verifies the liked timestamp and associated entities.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLikeOnComment entity and verifies the liked timestamp and associated entities.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Tests deleting a BuzzLikeOnShare entity and verifies it no longer exists in the repository.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Tests deleting a BuzzLikeOnComment entity and verifies it no longer exists.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a specific BuzzLikeOnShare and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a specific BuzzLikeOnComment and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Fetches a list of BuzzLikeOnShare objects based on filters and verifies the list contents.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of likes on shares for various share IDs.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Verifies the list of likes on comments based on comment ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of likes on comments for various comment IDs.
